about: Controls the window agent never presses, selects or toggles: what they do may not be taken back. Read by the sidecar (src/shared/consequential.ts) and by the native driver at the moment of the action (src-tauri/src/agent_wire.rs). English entries match whole words of the control's name (a phrase matches its words in a row); Arabic entries match anywhere in the name. A control with no name is refused as well: what it does cannot be judged.
